record.name: Gambler
record.description: You are a risk-taker, card player, or someone who lives by chance and luck. Whether you're a professional gambler, a con artist, or simply someone who enjoys the thrill of risk, your skills in deception, sleight of hand, and reading people make you dangerous. You understand the psychology of risk and know how to turn the odds in your favor.

feature.name: Lucky Streak
feature.description: Your experience with risk has given you an uncanny sense for when to take chances and when to fold. You can use your reaction to reroll one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw per long rest. Additionally, you have advantage on Deception checks when trying to bluff or mislead others.

effects.notes: Once per long rest, reroll any attack, check, or save
Advantage on Deception checks when bluffing

traits: I always have a plan for what to do when things go wrong.
I am incredibly slow to trust.
I am always calm, no matter what the situation.
I use multisyllabic words that others don't understand.
I have a strong sense of fair play.
I am haunted by memories of war.
I don't talk about the thing that torments me.
I idolize a particular hero of my faction and refer to them constantly.
ideals: Independence. I am a free spirit—no one tells me what to do.
Greed. I will do whatever it takes to become wealthy.
Freedom. Chains are meant to be broken, both for me and for others.
Power. I will do whatever it takes to become powerful.
Peace. I will not be the one to draw my weapon first.
bonds: I'm on the run from a crime lord I crossed.
I'm trying to pay off an old debt I owe to a benefactor.
My ill-gotten gains go to support my family.
I have a family to provide for.
I owe a debt to the person who trained me.
I am searching for my former master.
flaws: I can't resist a pretty face.
When I see something valuable, I can't think about anything but how to steal it.
When faced with a choice between my friends and my mission, I'll choose my mission.
I'll do anything for a big payday.
I am haunted by the memory of a bounty that went wrong.
I am a sucker for a pretty face.
